gradual_evolution.targets: fresh + nine full signed mature closed cuboid parameter profiles

dark_power_path_071.scope: Ordinary living Dark adult with locked POWER FIRST evolution; full signed later axes including opposite Run.
dark_power_path_071.reference: Fresh actual Chao Island red Power FIRST checkbox, full Dark alignment, age/axis/orbit controls. Model author personally opened young front/side, all nine mature front/side/back and all nine half-age front/side/back sheets. Actual source has one striped central horn, Run/Fly distal forks, no Run-first rear quills or separate front-side nubs.
dark_power_path_071.approximation: Original square skull retained. Three closed central boxes provide a stepped/bent striped horn; two small closed distal branches develop as Run/Fly lobes and remain positively embedded for single-horn targets. Run lengthens backward and raises its fork; Power thickens and raises a zigzag center; Fly extends rearward and droops its fork; Swim curls down/back; PowerSwim compresses into a low cap. Mixed corners keep distinct parameters. Curved/tapered spirals, source changing skull mass and conical fists are simplified. Linear age/bilinear training is authored timing, not extracted source formulas.
dark_power_path_071.paint_policy: Eight unused strip texels alternate broad body/mid pigments along the actual central horn and tail box spans; original skull and forehead art remain intact. Fork lobes use body-to-tip pigments. Existing compact hand islands receive broad source-informed bands without UV/geometry stretching.
dark_power_path_071.wing_policy: Three closed rays per wing approximate the source compact bat membrane and colored rim on original hinges; Fly broadens the fan. Existing Dark world-orientation and late-floor fit are reused through the scoped sibling predicate on production clocks.
dark_power_path_071.body_contact_policy: Torso top extends .45modelpixels for existing scoped walking lift; wrists keep original upper plane and soles/heels fixed. Limbs remain compact rectangular boxes rather than source conical hands.
dark_power_path_071.fork_policy: Distal lobes share the central tip region. Run raises a gold fork, Fly droops wider blue lobes, RunFly flattens a fork, RunSwim makes tiny up/out lobes and PowerFly keeps shorter drooping lobes. For young/balanced/Power/Swim/PowerSwim two tiny separate positive cuboids remain embedded in the terminal horn; no opacity swap or zero-size geometry.
dark_power_path_071.marker_policy: Original dot core/expression joints/visibility exact; six same-bone closed protrusions interpret the source Dark spiked ball.
dark_power_path_071.tail_policy: Two connected closed striped boxes retain original tail base/joint and approximate the source pointed conical tail. Distal width .75 and thickness .55 modelpixels stay inside the established shared prone-transition envelope; original length, centers, rotations and existing scoped folding pivot remain unchanged.
dark_power_path_071.provisional_rates: 960current level-bar progress per opposing axis, independent adult maturity. Viewer establishes no original-game level or morph formula.
